name: Tenma Momiji
source:
One of the Dai Tenma and a pillar of Yatsukahagi.

Oftenly called as the only rational person among the Tenmas. Even in the hostile position, she's still not someone so aggressive that will fight just because few words are exchanged.

She's the one that built up the instituitons and country in Edo.

"My own self can not remember exactly the face of other people. Ara, in the end who was it? I can not remember anymore."

[spoiler]In truth she is one of the female character in [url=https://vndb.org/v548#main]Dies Irae[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28996]Lisa Brenner[/url], after the death of [url=https://vndb.org/c29001]Marie[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c28998]Mercurius[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c22061]Reinhard Heydrich[/url], she along with other survived members of Marie universe joined in the group formed by [url=https://vndb.org/c22060]Ren[/url] in order to protect what's left of her world.[/spoiler]
